company_stage: large public membership warehouse retail company

culture_principles.name: Public mission and customer-impact alignment
culture_principles.description: Costco fit should connect work to the company outcomes and users described in cited public sources.

culture_principles.name: Evidence-backed execution
culture_principles.description: Strong answers should show practical judgment, clear tradeoffs, ownership, and outcomes rather than generic enthusiasm.

culture_principles.name: Member value as the operating constraint
culture_principles.description: Public material consistently ties decisions to member price and value, which makes cost-to-serve and waste reduction central rather than optional.

culture_principles.name: Long-tenure employee care
culture_principles.description: The company is publicly known for comparatively strong pay and retention in retail, which shapes expectations around scheduling fairness and internal promotion.

culture_principles.name: Operational simplicity at scale
culture_principles.description: A limited-assortment, high-volume model rewards people who simplify processes and protect throughput rather than adding variation.

hiring_signals.signal: Connects decisions to the users, customers, products, or markets named in public company sources.
Uses concrete examples to show ownership, learning, and measurable improvement.
Reasons about cost, throughput, and waste with concrete numbers from a real operation.
Handles a member or customer problem by fixing the cause, not only the immediate complaint.
Shows respect for frontline constraints when proposing a process or systems change.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Generic admiration for the company without a concrete role, customer, product, or business mechanism.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public lens usage should stay grounded in cited source signals and role-relevant evidence.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Assuming all Costco roles are warehouse-floor roles or that retail pace equals corporate pace.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The lens covers multiple role families and public sources do not support one uniform working model.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Using 'good pay and benefits' as a substitute for role-specific motivation.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Compensation reputation is widely reported but says nothing about fit for the specific work.

interview_patterns.pattern: Use cited public source signals to test role-relevant judgment, ownership, communication, and impact.

honest_limits: This is a lightweight public-source lens and does not represent an official Costco hiring standard.
It contains source metadata and non-verbatim public-safe signals only.
Role, team, seniority, location, and hiring manager can materially change interview emphasis.
This lens requires deeper multi-source validation before being promoted to FULLY_DISTILLED.
